Además de los cuatro elementos, la astro: Besides the four elements, astrology sorts the signs into three modalities that describe "how" that energy is expressed: the cardinal signs (Aries, Cancer, Libra, Capricorn) start movements and are great at kicking off projects; the fixed signs (Taurus, Leo, Scorpio, Aquarius) sustain and stabilize what's already begun, with remarkable staying power; and the mutable signs (Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, Pisces) adapt and ease the transitions from one stage to the next. Crossing element and modality (for example, "cardinal fire" for Aries) gives an even more precise picture of each sign's temperament.
Además de su posición vertical, muchos l: Besides their upright position, many readers also use reversed cards (those that land "upside down" when drawn) as an additional layer of nuance. Rather than simply meaning "the opposite," they often suggest that the card's energy is blocked, is internal rather than external, or needs more time to manifest. It's an optional practice: plenty of experienced tarot readers read only upright cards for years before deciding to add reversals.
Además del clásico Rider-Waite-Smith, ex: Besides the classic Rider-Waite-Smith, there are other major schools of tarot with their own visual rules. The Thoth deck, created by Aleister Crowley and Lady Frieda Harris, uses much denser astrological and numerological symbolism, recommended once you have already mastered the basics. Themed decks (nature, mythology, cats, dark or pastel) keep the classic 78-card structure but reinterpret the images with total artistic freedom — they make an excellent second deck once you know the traditional meanings well, because they force you to recognize each card's archetype beyond its specific illustration.
Además del elemento, la <strong>modalida: Besides the element, the modality adds nuance. Cardinal signs (Aries, Cancer, Libra, Capricorn) tend to make the first move. Fixed signs (Taurus, Leo, Scorpio, Aquarius) take their time, but when they give themselves over, they do it with depth and memory. Mutable signs (Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, Pisces) adapt to the moment and often surprise you with their spontaneity.

Además del punto de inicio, el punto fin: Besides the starting point, the end point of the heart line provides valuable information. A line that ends right between the index and middle fingers suggests a romantic approach balanced between reason and passion. If it curves upward, toward the index finger itself, it signals romantic idealism and high standards in a partner. If it ends more horizontally, almost straight toward the edge of the hand, it may indicate a person who greatly values independence even within a committed relationship.
Además del signo, la astrología observa: Besides the sign, astrology looks at which phase the Moon was in when you were born: new, waxing, full, or waning. Samhain (se pronuncia aproximadamente “s: Samhain (pronounced roughly “SOW-in”) is a festival of Celtic origin that was celebrated between October 31 and November 1, halfway between the autumn equinox and the winter solstice. It marked the end of the harvest, a time of turning inward, and the start of the dark half of the year. A widely held, symbolic belief says that around these dates the “veil” between the world of the living and the world of the dead grows thinner. Much of what we now know as Halloween comes from Samhain and the eve of All Saints' Day.
